name: Trip Cancelled
description: Sent to every registered participant when a trip is deleted or cancelled
subject: {trip_name} has been cancelled
body_html:
Trip Cancelled

Dear {participant_name},

A trip you are registered for has been cancelled and will no longer take place.

Cancelled trip

Trip{trip_name}
Destination{destination}
Dates{trip_dates}
Cancelled on{cancelled_date}

{reason_line}

Your registration has been closed. If you paid for this trip, the trips office will be in touch about a refund.

If you have any questions, contact the trips office.

{signature}

trip_dates.description: Trip dates, already formatted (a single date for single-day trips)

reason_line.description: Why it was cancelled; omitted when no reason was given

separator.description: Visual separator for the text version

signature.description: Email signature; supplied by the renderer when omitted
